race.title: Support The Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: JETEYE has been well placed by the shrewd Sam England team and can notch a sixth success of the year. The main danger looks to be Crafty Gael , who arrives in similarly rude health, while Speed Davis may prove best of the rest under a promising claimer. JETEYE (IRE) CRAFTY GAEL (IRE) SPEED DAVIS (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Jeteye (10/3), Crafty Gael (4/1), Vanilla Dancer (11/2), Speed Davis (6/1), Noonetellsmenothin (6/1), Sunset Hill (10/1), East Eagle (10/1), Quercus Robur (12/1), Loulou Madrik (14/1)
